title: BUG: indexing with monotonic decreasing DTI

labels.name: Indexing
labels.description: Related to indexing on series/frames, not to indexes themselves

body:
Hi there, I'm trying to add a column of time using pandas. But some dates doesn't work fine in string format. I'm working on jupyter notebook with Anaconda 4.3.0

Here's what I'm trying to do:

```python
data1 = data.head()
date_list = ["2018-01-02", "2017-02-10","2016-03-10", "2015-03-15", "2014-03-16"]
date_index = pd.to_datetime(date_list)
data1['date'] = date_index
data1
```
And the output is shown below.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16774189/35281474-f66c7f82-008d-11e8-88cd-743bd4e106fc.png)

Then I try to set 'date' as the index of this data frame.
```python
data1 = data1.set_index("date")
print(data1.index)
data1
```
This looks reasonable, too.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16774189/35281438-d85e7f4a-008d-11e8-9c43-d2d00b71d3e0.png)

Something weird happens when I try to index data using:
```python
data1.loc['2018-01-02']
```
It raises KeyError!!! 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16774189/35281042-e5508b36-008c-11e8-935b-f8aec3e5e4c3.png)

But other dates work fine. For example:
```python
data1.loc['2015-03-15']
```
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16774189/35281177-44411cdc-008d-11e8-8bbb-1fe5d959b320.png)

Why is that?
